lines.text: @maya_front sits on a park bench, pulling her laces tight.
A jogger runs past, far behind her, small against the trees.
@maya_front glances up and watches the runner shrink down the path.
She double-knots the laces and stands.
@maya_front bounces on her toes, eyes on the path.
She breathes out and sets off, quick and light.
The bench sits empty as she runs toward the distant jogger.

writes.note: I drafted a short park scene from your line, keeping @maya_front and leaving out the jogger tag, which has no reference.
